description: Correct who is travelling on a booking the traveller has not paid for yet: a passenger's name or date of birth (names exactly as on the passport, dates YYYY-MM-DD). Give only what changes, by position: { passenger: 2, name: "Sophie Hougham", dateOfBirth: "1990-04-12" }. What you leave out stays as it was. The link already sent opens with the new names; nothing is resent. Refused once the traveller has paid: names on a ticket are changed with the airline through Vuelo support.

leadTraveller.description: The booking traveller's email, date of birth and home postcode, town and county, to fill in their Vuelo account on the pay page.

passenger.description: Which passenger, from 1. Left out: by order in this list.

name: update_travellers
